tasks.title: Bounded identity-bound transport for operator-configured HTTP eval providers

acceptance.text: Real provider requests bind exact snapshot/suite/model and unique request IDs; pinned destination, separate credentials, no redirects, size/deadline/cancellation limits and malicious response handling pass. Transport is integrated into eval execution before adapter acceptance.

tasks.title: Scope parallel container cleanup assertions to their runner image

acceptance.text: Native/default and optional engine groups run concurrently without counting one another as leaks; cleanup still asserts no new containers for each immutable image. Failed CI attempt is retained and full CI reruns.

tasks.title: Immutable eval jobs and fenced per-trial recovery checkpoints

acceptance.text: Real PostgreSQL stages projected exact inputs and immutable units; concurrent claims, lease renewal/takeover, stale writers, normalized per-trial replay, cancellation and result immutability are tested. Restart resumes completed observations rather than rerunning or hiding them.

tasks.title: Credential-free Temporal evaluation worker and scoped database role

acceptance.text: Separate worker starts with no App/control secrets, only scoped eval database privileges and operator-pinned runner/provider configuration. Real Temporal activity retry, cancellation cleanup and replay are tested.

tasks.title: Recover containers left by process death using unit and lease ownership

acceptance.text: A killed worker leaves a real labeled container; the next fenced owner removes only prior containers for the same unit before resuming. Other units/services are untouched, stale owners cannot write, and cleanup failures cannot produce success.

tasks.title: Serialize repeatable schema and evaluator-role initialization

acceptance.text: Concurrent migration callers initialize a fresh dedicated test database without catalog/role races, retain exact schemas and grants, and repeat safely. Applicable full CI includes this test.

tasks.title: Stable per-unit trial request IDs and provider deduplication contract

acceptance.text: Real provider receives the same UUID for an interrupted uncommitted trial on retry, different IDs for distinct trials/units, and no request for retained observations. Provider deduplicates without double execution; mismatched payload reuse is rejected and invalid request IDs cannot dispatch. Scope and at-least-once limits are documented and full CI passes.

tasks.title: UBI eval worker runtime with pinned official Docker CLI and real image acceptance

acceptance.text: UBI non-root eval-worker image includes current stable official pinned Docker CLI, no package installers/controller credentials, and passes real restricted PostgreSQL/Temporal execution, child isolation, shutdown/restart and vulnerability scans. Applicable CI builds and verifies it; published native/download gates remain separately required.

tasks.title: Expose missing impact-required eval classes

acceptance.text: Tool changes without contract suites and permission/policy changes without policy or adversarial suites report explicit selection gaps, including through frozen-base comparison plans; unrelated changes do not fabricate gaps. Regression checks and full CI pass.

tasks.title: Identity-bound durable comparison evidence contract

acceptance.text: Strict comparison evidence binds organization/repository/PR/base/head/review/attempt and planned unit provenance, recomputes deltas/outcome, cannot pass missing or cancelled execution/coverage, exposes no projected source or credentials, and rejects forged identities/digests/summary. Real durable storage snapshot read and full CI verify it before API/PR integration.

tasks.title: Authenticated eval comparison API and installed agent client

acceptance.text: Additive OpenAPI/domain/shared fixtures match authenticated comparison GET, typed identity/digest errors and bounded responses; unauthorized callers cannot disclose IDs, scopes cannot cross, storage failures are sanitized, M1 compatibility passes, compiled API and installed client consume actual durable evidence. Full CI validates final source. Upper/lowercase comparison resource and expected UUID identities yield identical canonical evidence and full export hashes across native persistence, HTTP and installed client; different identities still fail, and retained digests and released compatibility remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Bounded complete access to large comparison evidence

acceptance.text: Valid large comparison evidence remains fully consumable using bounded snapshot-consistent traversal or export; stale snapshots have explicit retry semantics, no result loss/truncation or false passing summary, and real persistence/API/installed-client tests verify capacity before phase closure.

tasks.title: Stage exact PR comparison plans with operator provenance and budgets

acceptance.text: Controller compiles exact Git base/head plans, freezes baseline suites for both subjects, keeps added suites head-only, expands every configured model variant, pins operator runner/provider identities and enforces total budgets. Scoped staging is idempotent by review/attempt, retains zero-selected/gapped plans, returns only identifiers to workflow history, and real provider/PostgreSQL acceptance verifies retry and identity conflicts before child dispatch.

tasks.title: Durable PR parent orchestration with child cleanup and replay

acceptance.text: New PR evaluation parent stages exact identifiers, dispatches separate evaluator children with deterministic identity, waits for completion and cancellation cleanup, retains cancelled evidence on stale PR or failure, and preserves M1 replay. Real PostgreSQL/Temporal/isolated runner tests prove baseline/head results, no source/credentials in histories, stale/cancel cleanup and replay before Check publication is wired.

tasks.title: Publish bounded behavioral evidence with exact PR identity and retry reconciliation

acceptance.text: Completed SQL snapshot exports produce bounded Check summaries containing exact base/head, suite/model deltas, regressions, added/removed/changed scenarios, coverage/selection/execution gaps and immutable evidence references. Publication rechecks current PR identity under the shared lock, reconciles only this App and exact attempt, rejects pending/cancelled or mismatched evidence, sanitizes SDK failures and preserves M1 Check behavior. Actual HTTP provider/PostgreSQL tests prove stale identity, retries including ambiguous writes, lock contention and no false passing summaries before production workflow wiring.

tasks.title: Wire durable controller outbox to full review/eval lifecycle and publication

acceptance.text: Compiled M2 controller requires pinned eval configuration and M2 schema, registers legacy and new activities/workflows without changing M1 command history, and durable outbox starts a deterministic exact-attempt full workflow. Real PostgreSQL/Temporal/HTTP Git+Checks/isolated evaluator tests verify semantic and behavioral publication, retry/outbox duplicate fencing, current-head outcomes, failure and cancellation recovery. Container readiness and installed-client acceptance pass; no silent M1 fallback, App credentials in evaluator payloads, or phase completion before live/release gates.

tasks.title: Scoped operator review CLI with fresh attempts and safe ambiguous submission retries

acceptance.text: Installed agentci review reads only a private strict operator config and existing scoped App/webhook credentials, fetches current open PR identity from GitHub, submits an HMAC-signed request to the existing route with a fresh UUID, validates queued/duplicate response and emits only receipt metadata. Supplied UUID safely repeats ambiguous transport submission without rewriting cancelled evidence. Tests reject unsafe config/permissions/origin, closed/mismatched PRs, redirects, forged/oversized replies, secret leakage and read-only evidence-token scheduling; native controller and real customer acceptance prove a new review without close/reopen. Docs, operation/scenario mapping, packaging and exact-source full CI pass before completion.

tasks.title: Reconcile abruptly closed review attempts and cancelled evaluator orphans

acceptance.text: Tracked controller attempts reconcile actual Temporal terminal state after failure, timeout or termination without restarting an immutable failed UUID. Scoped SQL cancellation and unavailable/cancelled Checks retain prior evidence; concurrent/restarted reconcilers are fenced and transient SDK/publication failures retry without false closure. Native tests terminate a real parent with both containers running and after an evaluator SIGKILL, then recover with no owned containers, correct terminal evidence and exactly one Check. A fresh operator UUID recovers independently; legacy M1 replay, additive checksum-bound migration, private error handling, docs/operation mappings, package/container and exact-source full CI pass.

tasks.title: Make unavailable Checks expose retained evidence and correct fresh-attempt recovery guidance

Native and installed customer verification prove correct links, immutable earlier evidence and unchanged exact-head reconciliation; docs, API/scenario mapping, packaging and exact-source CI pass.
